title: Enforcement against Businesses who Raise Prices Using GST Increase as Excuse
what_it_is: Enforcement against Businesses who Raise Prices Using GST Increase as Excuse

sections.label: CAP review and GST misrepresentation
sections.summary: The CAP will review feedback, engage businesses where necessary, and is prepared to publicly highlight businesses that persist in GST misrepresentation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The CAP will continue to review all feedback received and will engage businesses, where necessary, to address the issue.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The CAP is prepared to publicly highlight egregious businesses which persist in GST misrepresentation.

sections.label: IRAS advisory on price adjustments
sections.summary: IRAS issued an advisory for businesses adjusting prices on how to communicate reasons for price or fee adjustments to consumers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) has recently issued an advisory for businesses which need to adjust their prices, on how they should communicate their reasons for price or fee adjustments to consumers.

sections.label: MTI monitors essential prices
sections.summary: MTI monitors prices of essential products and services through the Department of Statistics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: One, I want to say that the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) monitors the prices of essential products and services via one of our agencies called the Department of Statistics (DOS).

sections.label: Price Kaki App difference
sections.summary: A difference this round compared to 2007 to 2009 is that the Price Kaki App exists.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Another important thing that is quite different this round as compared to 2007 to 2009 when we last stood up the CAP, is that we have the Price Kaki App.

sections.label: Price Kaki app unit prices
sections.summary: The Price Kaki app helps Singaporeans make informed purchasing decisions, and on 1 January CASE added a function to view and compare unit prices of over 1,200 grocery items.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Price Kaki app will allow our fellow Singaporeans to make informed purchasing decisions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I am also happy to inform Ms Foo that recently, on 1 January this year, CASE added a new function on the app, which allows our consumers to view and compare the unit prices of more than 1,200 grocery items.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This feature came about because we hear a lot of feedback from fellow Singaporeans, about the need to understand the price changes for a unit of a product.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This feature helps the consumer to distinguish and compare the per unit value of pre-packaged products of different brands and similar products of differing quantity, volume or packaging.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: MTI and CCCS will continue to work closely with the CASE team to continue to strengthen and enhance the Price Kaki app to empower our fellow Singaporeans to make informed purchasing decisions.
